opsz.name: Optical Size
opsz.description: Adapt the style to specific text sizes.

ARRR.name: AR Retinal Resolution
ARRR.description: Resolution-specific enhancements in AR/VR typefaces to optimize rendering across the different resolutions of the headsets making designs accessible and easy to read.

BLED.name: Bleed
BLED.description: Bleed adjusts the overall darkness in the typographic color of strokes or other forms, without any changes in overall width, line breaks, or page layout.

BNCE.name: Bounce
BNCE.description: Shift glyphs up and down in the Y dimension, resulting in an uneven, bouncy baseline.

CASL.name: Casual
CASL.description: Adjust stroke curvature, contrast, and terminals from a sturdy, rational Linear style to a friendly, energetic Casual style.

CRSV.name: Cursive
CRSV.description: Control the substitution of cursive forms along the Slant axis.

CTRS.name: Contrast
CTRS.description: Contrast describes the stroke width difference between the thick and thin parts of the font glyphs.

EHLT.name: Edge Highlight
EHLT.description: Controls thickness of edge highlight details.

ELGR.name: Element Grid
ELGR.description: In modular fonts, where glyphs are composed using multiple copies of the same element, this axis controls how many elements are used per one grid unit.

ELSH.name: Element Shape
ELSH.description: In modular fonts, where glyphs are composed using multiple copies of the same element, this axis controls the shape of the element

ELXP.name: Element Expansion
ELXP.description: As the Element Expansion axis progresses, the elements move apart.

ENLA.name: Enlarge
ENLA.description: Scales lowercase letters to an intermediate size between minuscule and majuscule, as used in medieval manuscripts for enlarged minuscules at sentence openings.

FILL.name: Fill
FILL.description: Fill in transparent forms with opaque ones.

FLAR.name: Flare
FLAR.description: As the flare axis grows, the stem terminals go from straight (0%) to develop a swelling (100%).

GDOP.name: Guides Opacity
GDOP.description: Adjust opacity of guides from 100 (fully visible) down to 0 (fully invisible).

GEOM.name: Geometric Form
GEOM.description: It transforms complex letterforms into simplified geometric shapes like circles, triangles, and squares.

GRAD.name: Grade
GRAD.description: Finesse the style from lighter to bolder in typographic color, without any changes overall width, line breaks or page layout.

HEXP.name: Hyper Expansion
HEXP.description: Expansion of inner and outer space of glyphs.

INFM.name: Informality
INFM.description: Adjusts overall design from formal and traditional (0%) to informal and unconventional (up to 100%).

JITT.name: Jitter
JITT.description: Controls the amount of jitter applied to the glyphs.

MONO.name: Monospace
MONO.description: Adjust the style from Proportional (natural widths, default) to Monospace (fixed width).

MORF.name: Morph
MORF.description: Letterforms morph: Changing in unconventional ways, that don't alter other attributes, like width or weight.

ROND.name: Roundness
ROND.description: Adjust shapes from angular defaults (0%) to become increasingly rounded (up to 100%).

SCAN.name: Scanlines
SCAN.description: Break up shapes into horizontal segments without any changes in overall width, letter spacing, or kerning, so there are no line breaks or page layout changes.

SHLN.name: Shadow Length
SHLN.description: Adjusts the font's shadow length from no shadow visible (0 %) to a maximum shadow applied (100%) relative to each family design.

SHRP.name: Sharpness
SHRP.description: Adjust shapes from angular or blunt default shapes (0%) to become increasingly sharped forms (up to 100%).

SOFT.name: Softness
SOFT.description: Adjust letterforms to become more and more soft and rounded.

SPAC.name: Spacing
SPAC.description: Adjusts the overall letter spacing of a font.

SZP1.name: Size of Paint 1
SZP1.description: Modifies the size of a paint element going from an initial size (0) to positive values that increase the size (100%) or negative values that shrink it down (-100%).

SZP2.name: Size of Paint 2
SZP2.description: Modifies the size of a paint element going from an initial size (0) to positive values that increase the size (100%) or negative values that shrink it down (-100%).

VOLM.name: Volume
VOLM.description: Expands and exaggerates details of a typeface to emphasize the personality.

WONK.name: Wonky
WONK.description: Toggle the substitution of wonky forms.

XELA.name: Horizontal Element Alignment
XELA.description: Align glyph elements from their default position (0%), usually the baseline, to a rightmost (100%) or leftmost (-100%) position.

XOPQ.name: Thick Stroke
XOPQ.description: A parametric axis for varying thick stroke weights, such as stems.

XPN1.name: Horizontal Position of Paint 1
XPN1.description: The position of the paint moves left and right.

XPN2.name: Horizontal Position of Paint 2
XPN2.description: The position of the paint moves left and right.

XROT.name: Rotation in X
XROT.description: Glyphs rotate left and right, negative values to the left and positive values to the right, in the X dimension.

XTRA.name: Counter Width
XTRA.description: A parametric axis for varying counter widths in the X dimension.

YEAR.name: Year
YEAR.description: Axis that shows in a metaphoric way the effect of time on a chosen topic.

YELA.name: Vertical Element Alignment
YELA.description: Align glyphs elements from their default position (0%), usually the baseline, to an upper (100%) or lower (-100%) position.

YEXT.name: Vertical Extension
YEXT.description: The axis extends glyphs in the Y dimension, such as the Cap Height, Ascender and Descender lengths.

YOPQ.name: Thin Stroke
YOPQ.description: A parametric axis for varying thin stroke weights, such as bars and hairlines.

YPN1.name: Vertical Position of Paint 1
YPN1.description: The position of the paint moves up and down.

YPN2.name: Vertical Position of Paint 2
YPN2.description: The position of the paint moves up and down.

YROT.name: Rotation in Y
YROT.description: Glyphs rotate up and down, negative values tilt down and positive values tilt up, in the Y dimension.

YTAS.name: Ascender Height
YTAS.description: A parametric axis for varying the height of lowercase ascenders.

YTDE.name: Descender Depth
YTDE.description: A parametric axis for varying the depth of lowercase descenders.

YTFI.name: Figure Height
YTFI.description: A parametric axis for varying the height of figures.

YTLC.name: Lowercase Height
YTLC.description: A parametric axis for varying the height of the lowercase.

YTUC.name: Uppercase Height
YTUC.description: A parametric axis for varying the heights of uppercase letterforms.

ZROT.name: Rotation in Z
ZROT.description: Glyphs rotate left and right, negative values to the left and positive values to the right, in the Z dimension.

ital.name: Italic
ital.description: Adjust the style from roman to italic.

slnt.name: Slant
slnt.description: Adjust the style from upright to slanted.

wdth.name: Width
wdth.description: Adjust the style from narrower to wider, by varying the proportions of counters, strokes, spacing and kerning, and other aspects of the type.

wght.name: Weight
wght.description: Adjust the style from lighter to bolder in typographic color, by varying stroke weights, spacing and kerning, and other aspects of the type.
